```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(tidysurv)       # helper package for survival metrics (if not installed, see note below)
library(ranger)         # backend for random forest survival
library(survival)
library(censored)

set.seed(42)
```

Prepare data
```{r}
# Recode: 1=censored, 2=event → 0/1
lung$status <- ifelse(lung$status == 2, 1, 0)

# Keep relevant columns
lung <- lung[, c("time", "status", "age", "sex")]

# Split train/test (optional)
set.seed(42)
data_split <- initial_split(lung, prop = 0.7)
train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data  <- testing(data_split)

# Define 5-fold CV
set.seed(42)
cv_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)
```

Define the modeling recipe and model specification
```{r}
rsf_spec <- rand_forest(
  mode  = "censored regression",
  trees = 500,
  mtry  = tune(),
  min_n = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("partykit")

rsf_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rsf_spec) %>%
  add_formula(Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex)
```

Cross validation
```{r}
set.seed(42)
rsf_grid <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(1, 3)),
  min_n(range = c(5, 15)),
  levels = 3
)


# Register the metric
rsf_metrics <- metric_set(yardstick::concordance_survival)
```

Tune model
```{r}
# Tune
set.seed(42)
rsf_tuned <- tune_grid(
  rsf_wf,
  resamples = cv_folds,
  grid = rsf_grid,
  metrics = rsf_metrics
)

collect_metrics(rsf_tuned)
```

Select best combination
```{r}
best_rsf <- select_best(rsf_tuned, metric = "concordance_survival")
```

Fit model
```{r}
final_rsf <- finalize_workflow(rsf_wf, best_rsf)
rsf_fit <- fit(final_rsf, data = lung)
```

Test dataset
```{r}
rsf_pred_time <- predict(rsf_fit, new_data = test_data, type = "time")
risk_score <- -rsf_pred_time$.pred_time

surv_obj <- with(test_data, Surv(time, status))
test_cindex <- survival::concordance(surv_obj ~ risk_score)$concordance
test_cindex
```
